summary: A silent renewal failure let the edge certificate expire; a client-side check now fails 14 days before expiry.

  keywords: [certificate expired, tls handshake]
  paths: [roles/proxy/]

  observable: openssl x509 -noout -checkend 1209600 on the served certificate
  expected: exit 0 while 14 days or more are left
---

## Symptom

Every client failed the TLS handshake after the 'renewal failed' line was logged and ignored.

## Contributing factor

The renewal job logged its failure and still exited 0.

## Root cause

Nothing measured certificate lifetime from the client side, so a failed renewal looked like a successful one.

## Preventive control

A daily client-side check fails when the served certificate has fewer than 14 days left.
